action: Activate network campaign in earnest. Reach out directly to Robert Jackson — highest-trust contact, rideshare driver, frontline observer of what RoboRide is doing to human-driven transport in Millfield. Have a real conversation: what is the trajectory, what are operators saying, what skills transfer. Use that intelligence to sharpen my job applications. Simultaneously send direct messages to three professional contacts — Carlos Ruiz, Rachel Green, and Betty Kowalski — letting them know I am exploring operations roles outside parking and asking if they know of anything in facilities, logistics, or property management. This is the campaign I committed to. Quiet professional networking, no drama, but deliberate and active.
